description: Avery Dennison Corporation, founded in 1935 and incorporated in Delaware in 1977 as Avery International Corporation and renamed Avery Dennison Corporation in 1990 when it merged a subsidiary into Dennison Manufacturing Company, is a global leader in materials science and digital identification solutions. It provides branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency and reduce waste, and its performance tapes products include a variety of Fasson-brand and Avery Dennison-brand tapes and other pressure-sensitive adhesive-based materials and converted products, mechanical fasteners and performance polymers, whose pressure-sensitive adhesive-based materials are used in non-mechanical fastening, bonding and sealing systems for automotive, electronics, building and construction, general industrial, personal care and medical applications.
